description: This Java class 'Request' handles HTTP-like requests over Bluetooth connections, including request creation, sending, listening, and response parsing.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Handles HTTP-like request operations over Bluetooth, including request creation, sending, listening, and response processing.

methods.name: createHEAD
methods.description: Creates a new Request object with the HEAD method.

methods.name: createGET
methods.description: Creates a new Request object with the GET method.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the HTTP request over Bluetooth and returns a Response object.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Listens for an incoming request over Bluetooth, parsing the request line and headers.

methods.name: listenForRequest
methods.description: Static method that waits for an incoming Bluetooth request and returns a Request object if successful.

methods.name: readResponseCode
methods.description: Reads and parses the response status code from the input stream.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the input stream.

methods.name: readHeaders
methods.description: Reads HTTP headers from the input stream.
